verified: Public prepare_inputs, installed_profile, build_request independently exercised without private test helpers; register exercised by existing full NativeWorkflow tests with synthetic framework authority. These APIs require actual root-owned installation, live representative evaluation, admitted role and signed grant before real production.

Captured actual stdin passed to owned-process boundary contains bounded original task/files plus system and step governance once; native_binding and authority key are absent. Original/governance/effective digests independently compared.

NativeModelHost independently computes effective input digest and validates private response/proposal against it. Adapter retains this trusted terminal in call_end. Launcher checks original_request_digest and proposal input_digest against trusted call_end input_digest. This is not only model-authored metadata; launcher does not reconstruct effective messages a second time.

Canonical installation identity stable across mapping order; installation/runtime/evaluation drift and old grants rejected by source-bound checks. Authority key excluded by environment name and value. Request bounds reject before owned-process dispatch.

Explicit validation_probe rejected for production even with evaluation scope live; synthetic evaluation cannot authorize a non-validation task. Live label alone is not proof of provider use or external admission.

NativeWorker owns launcher process tree; helper closure precedes output collection. Cancellation and nonzero/partial application yield no accepted candidate. Existing full-chain test verifies two concurrent tasks, physical closure, independent candidate checking and NativeIntegration; usage terminal remains null.

Central SQLite transactions reserve task maximum calls permanently and lease concurrent execution. Independent actual os._exit(23) after reservation leaves active lease; replay, another concurrent task and alternate directory rejected. Existing tests verify reauthorization cannot reset budget and separate-task execution works.

Unknown native result retains valid confirmed raw usage in protocol_evidence, enters reconciliation, and does not retry/fallback. Existing tests verify one call_start and unchanged failed raw last/total; no invented normalized CLI counters or observed model.
Existing HTTP semantics and executable runtime scenarios pass; frozen framework and subscription transport not edited by this review.
